gaps.description: Kaiser Permanente is a brand/system umbrella; no universal standalone EIN is asserted
Exact current EINs for the independent regional Permanente Medical Groups are not established by the gathered primary sources
This minimal fixture does not inventory every health-plan subsidiary, PMG, KFH subsidiary, Risant affiliate, or other Kaiser-associated legal entity
Eight PMG regions do not imply a one-to-one map to eight health-plan corporations, and legal domicile does not define complete service area
All facility owner, operator, DBA, CCN, NPI, PAC ID, and state-license relationships are not inventoried; identifier types must remain distinct
The 2024 reporting perimeter includes Risant Health and must not be back-projected or silently attributed to a single EIN
